name: marketplace-api-contract
description: Marketplace API coursework: OpenAPI contract, typed config, SQL data layer and a TypeORM layer with migrations

scripts.migrate: bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev npx typeorm migration:run -d dist/data-source.js
scripts.migrate:show: bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev npx typeorm migration:show -d dist/data-source.js
scripts.migrate:revert: bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev npx typeorm migration:revert -d dist/data-source.js
scripts.migrate:generate: bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev npx typeorm migration:generate -d dist/data-source.js
scripts.db:schema: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U marketplace -d marketplace -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f - < db/schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U marketplace -d marketplace -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f - < db/seed.sql
scripts.db:indexes: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U marketplace -d marketplace -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f - < db/indexes.sql && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U marketplace -d marketplace -q -c "ANALYZE;"
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U marketplace -d marketplace
